decisions.reason: The source proposes copy for a no-referral result modal and does not direct any change to landing-page content or layout.
The modal-specific copy does not require revision of the About page or its prize-mechanics content.
The client limits the proposal to modal copy and does not request corresponding FAQ revisions; propagating its wording to the FAQ would require an additional interpretation.
The candidate already requires a $12 no-referral commission allocated randomly through a weighted draw; the modal copy describes that existing behavior without changing it.

The singular '$1,250 prize draw ticket' wording may be only user-facing shorthand, or it may conflict with the current six-ticket rule and identify a changed draw value; the source does not safely resolve whether mechanics changed.
The source changes an on-screen modal and does not alter transactional-email delivery, contents, or notification channels.
Random assignment of a no-referral ticket and commission is distinct from the automatic wallet transfer of a prize after winning.
The modal-copy decision does not affect the landing-page book-cover placement, cropping, or size.
The $12 in the source is a no-referral commission awarded to an NFT holder, not a change to the mint-price allocation or founder share.
The source concerns no-referral reward feedback and does not alter optional gratuity behavior.
The proposed modal copy and its display timing do not change email authentication or dashboard-access behavior.
The source assumes a no-referral result presentation but does not modify the ability to complete a mint using USDC.
